name: player_register_gameplay_callbacks_and_ff
description: Player::RegisterGameplayCommandCallbacksAndCreateFfEffects installs gameplay hotkey callbacks, conditionally routes the software video-mode hotkey in software acceleration mode, and allocates/initializes the global force-feedback effect set.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly inspection in the current session verified command registrations for 30, 9, 32, 33, 35, 42, 43, 44, and 45 to HudUi::HandleHotkeyCommand, software-only command 34 to zVideo::HandleSoftwareModeHotkeyCommand, allocation of a 0x1c-byte zInput_FFEffectSet, initialization through zInputDI::InitForceFeedbackEffectSet, and null-storage on failed allocation.

The native smoke checks software and hardware acceleration registration behavior, callback table entries, keyboard dispatch registration side effects, and force-feedback set allocation/initialization in the no-joystick-device path.
The Binary Ninja reconstruction remains limited by exposed compiler SEH scaffolding, and no VC manifest covers 0x425920 yet; tier S verification is deferred to a Player/source-cluster pass.
